mechanism: Rilpivirine is a CYP3A4 substrate and weak inhibitor; irbesartan is metabolized by CYP2C9 with minimal CYP3A4 involvement, but rilpivirine may have indirect effects on cardiovascular homeostasis in HIV patients requiring careful monitoring.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function regularly; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is recommended in HIV-positive patients on combination therapy.
